gloss: degree of attention; level of interest; prominence
notes:
A compound noun frequently used in media, entertainment, and marketing to quantify or describe how much attention something is receiving. Often appears with ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high) or ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (low).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注目度|ちゅうもくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to attract much attention
- {注目度|ちゅうもくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: to receive little attention
- {注目度|ちゅうもくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: attention increases
- {注目度|ちゅうもくど}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧: attention/popularity ranking
- {注目度|ちゅうもくど}ナンバーワン: number one in attention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧: popularity — focuses on being liked, not just noticed
- ⟦{話題性|わだいせい}→話題性：26084_wadaisei⟧: topicality, buzz — the quality of being talked about
- ⟦{知名度|ちめいど}→知名度：13664_chimeido⟧: name recognition — how widely known something or someone is

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧ (attention, notice) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree, level).

definitions.gloss: degree of attention; level of interest; prominence
definitions.explanation: the extent to which something attracts public attention or interest; how noteworthy or prominent something is

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{注目度|ちゅうもくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This movie is getting a lot of attention.
